# Anne & Charlie Sloane

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Romantically involved with — [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) — proposed marriage to her and was rejected · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) go for an afternoon walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) through the park and along the harbor shore. After watching the sunset from a pavilion, they walk back via [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) points out a charming, quaint house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a strong presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings
